title: Heroku Safari 15 bundle deployment fix: existing production app was confirmed to have only heroku/ruby, causing Rails assets:precompile to invoke npm without a Node buildpack-installed toolchain. Repository now pins Node 24.13.0, avoids redundant npm install inside the Rails Rake hook, documents the required live buildpack order heroku/nodejs then heroku/ruby, and updates the Heroku production smoke workflow to install Node and JavaScript dependencies before Ruby asset precompile so CI mirrors deployment. app.json remains the template for new/review apps but is not treated as authority for existing app configuration.
